summary: Toyota Auto Finance Receivables LLC, as depositor for Toyota Auto Receivables 2026-D Owner Trust, filed an 8-K on October 15, 2026, disclosing retention of Morgan, Lewis & Bockius LLP as counsel for its Form SF-3 shelf registration (333-281727) and attaching legality, enforceability and tax opinions (Exhibits 5.1, 5.2, 8.1) with consents. The filing references a pending auto-loan ABS issuance, including $417,762,000 of 4.301% Class A-1 notes and $471,287,000 of a further class, sold by the depositor to underwriters. This is a routine shelf-takedown disclosure, not a special situation.
